xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Pursuant to the in-principle approval letters bearing No. LOD/PREF/PR/FIP/1608/2024-25 dated December 31, 2024 from BSE, and NSE/LIST/45282 dated December 31, 2024 from NSE, the Board of Directors of the Company, through a circular resolution passed on December 31, 2024, accorded their consent to allot 1,38,46,154 (One Crore Thirty-Eight Lakhs Forty-Six Thousand One Hundred and Fifty-Four) Zero Coupon Optionally Convertible Non-Cumulative Preference Shares (OCPS). Out of the said 1,38,46,154 OCPS; 1. 35,50,000 OCPS were converted into equity shares on January 29, 2025, and 2. 41,50,000 OCPS were converted into equity shares on May 8, 2025 For which the Company has obtained listing and trading approvals. 3. Further, 41,95,000 OCPS were converted into equity shares on June 18, 2026, for which the company has filed a listing application with the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd and BSE Limited. Post the receipt of the listing and trading approval for the converted shares, the equity shares shall be added to the listed capital. The remaining 19,51,154 OCPS are outstanding. Hence, there exists a difference between 1. Issued Capital and Listed Capital 2. Issued Capital and Total No. of Shares
